title: 一剪梅·舟过吴江
titlePy: Yī Jiǎn Méi · Zhōu Guò Wú Jiāng
titleEn: A Spray of Plum Blossom: Boating Past Wujiang
author: 蒋捷
intro: A homesick traveller drifts by boat through rain in late spring. It ends with one of the best-loved lines in Chinese about time slipping away: “the cherries turn red, the banana leaves turn green.”
analysis: 作者坐船经过吴江（今江苏苏州一带），心里有一片“春愁”，想用酒来浇灭。上阕写一路所见：江上的船在摇，岸上酒楼的酒旗在招手；经过“秋娘渡”和“泰娘桥”这些好听的地名，可是风雨飘飘萧萧，让人更愁。下阕写想家：什么时候才能回家，洗去旅途的风尘？想象家里调笙弹曲、点着心字形的香，温暖安宁。最后三句最有名：时光最容易把人抛在后面，樱桃红了，芭蕉绿了，春天就这样过去了。“红了”“绿了”把形容词当动词用，颜色在变，就是时间在走，写得非常生动。词里“风又飘飘，雨又萧萧”“银字笙调，心字香烧”句式整齐，读起来有音乐感。蒋捷因为这一句，被人称为“樱桃进士”。
analysisEn: The poet is travelling by boat past Wujiang, near Suzhou, carrying a “spring sorrow” he would like to drown in wine. The first half is what he sees on the way: his boat rocking on the river, a tavern flag beckoning from a building on the shore. He passes places with lovely names — Autumn Maiden Ferry, Tai Maiden Bridge — but the wind blows and the rain patters, and the sorrow only grows. The second half turns to home: when will he get back and wash the dust of the road from his robe? He pictures home — someone tuning a reed-pipe, coil incense burning in the shape of the character 心 (“heart”). Then the famous ending: time so easily leaves people behind — the cherries have turned red, the banana leaves have turned green. Here the colour words 红 and 绿 work as verbs: the colours are changing, and that change is time passing. The paired, rhythmic phrases (“wind blowing and blowing, rain pattering and pattering”) give the whole piece a musical feel. The last line was so admired that Jiang Jie was nicknamed “the Cherry Scholar”.
background: Jiang Jie (c. 1245–c. 1305) passed the highest civil examination in 1274, just before the Southern Song fell to the Mongols. Refusing to serve the new Yuan rulers, he lived in seclusion, and much of his work reflects a life of wandering.
pronunciation: 酒浇：浇 jiāo。秋娘渡：渡 dù。笙调：调 tiáo（调弄乐器）。红了、绿了：了 le，轻声。
version: 采用通行教材版本。个别本子“秋娘渡与泰娘桥”作“秋娘容与泰娘娇”，“何日归家洗客袍”作“何日云帆卸浦桥”，网站不用。

lines.py: yī piàn chūn chóu dài jiǔ jiāo
lines.lit: A stretch of spring sorrow waits for wine to wash it away.
lines.en: A whole spring’s sorrow, waiting for wine to drown it.

lines.py: jiāng shàng zhōu yáo, lóu shàng lián zhāo
lines.lit: On the river the boat rocks; on the building the curtain beckons.
lines.en: My boat rocks on the river; a tavern flag waves from a window.

lines.py: qiū niáng dù yǔ tài niáng qiáo
lines.lit: Autumn Maiden Ferry and Tai Maiden Bridge —
lines.en: Past Autumn Maiden Ferry, past Tai Maiden Bridge,

lines.py: fēng yòu piāo piāo, yǔ yòu xiāo xiāo
lines.lit: the wind blowing and blowing, the rain pattering and pattering.
lines.en: the wind keeps gusting, the rain keeps whispering down.

lines.py: hé rì guī jiā xǐ kè páo
lines.lit: What day will I return home and wash my traveller’s robe?
lines.en: When will I be home, washing the road from my robe?

lines.py: yín zì shēng tiáo, xīn zì xiāng shāo
lines.lit: The silver-marked reed pipe tuned, the heart-shaped incense burning.
lines.en: Tuning the silver-inlaid pipe, lighting heart-shaped incense.

lines.py: liú guāng róng yì bǎ rén pāo
lines.lit: Flowing time easily throws people behind —
lines.en: How easily time runs on and leaves us behind:

lines.py: hóng le yīng táo, lǜ le bā jiāo
lines.lit: reddened the cherries, greened the banana leaves.
lines.en: the cherries have turned red, the banana leaves green.

words.note: 春天引起的愁思，诗词常用。
现代汉语“浇花”；“借酒浇愁”今天仍是成语。
帘：酒旗，古代酒店挂的布招牌；招：招手。
渡：渡口。秋娘、泰娘都是唐代有名的歌女，这里是吴江一带的地名。
拟声词，诗词常用，如“风萧萧兮易水寒”。
客：在外的人，如“客人”“旅客”；袍：长衣。

words.en: a reed pipe inlaid with silver characters
words.note: 笙：一种吹奏乐器，今天还有。

words.en: incense coiled into the shape of 心
words.note: 古人把香做成“心”字形来烧。
时光像流水一样过去。现代书面语也说“流光溢彩”，意思不同。
现代汉语仍用。初夏成熟变红。
现代汉语仍用，南方常见的大叶植物。

imagery.name: 酒
imagery.zh: 想借酒浇愁，可见愁很重。
imagery.en: He wants wine to drown his sorrow — a sign of how heavy it is.

imagery.name: 船
imagery.zh: 江上摇晃的小船，是漂泊在外、身不由己的象征。
imagery.en: The boat rocking on the river stands for his drifting life away from home.

imagery.name: 桥
imagery.zh: 秋娘渡、泰娘桥名字美，却在风雨中一一经过，更显旅途的孤单。
imagery.en: Ferries and bridges with pretty names slip by in the rain, making the journey feel lonelier.

imagery.name: 芭蕉
imagery.zh: 芭蕉由浅变深地绿了，和红了的樱桃一起，写出春去夏来、时光飞逝。
imagery.en: The banana leaves deepening to green, with the cherries turning red, mark spring giving way to summer — time slipping past.
